rachel: Heads-up — onboarding sample-app surfaced an embeddings/rerank mismatch. We batch 5 docs, retrying a timed-out item produced a duplicated vector and scrambled ordering for rerank.

 tor: Oof — which helper + runtime?

 rachel: Node embed-helper v0.10 in sample-app. Timeline: send batch [d1,d2,d3,d4,d5] chunked into [d1,d2] & [d3,d4,d5]. d4 times out, we retry it solo. Responses arrive: chunk1, retry(d4), chunk2(d3,d5) -> helper concatenates arrivals -> final vectors [d1,d2,d4,d3,d5]. Rerank logic pairs by index -> wrong doc scores. Also saw a duplicate when both the chunk response and the retry landed and helper didn't dedupe by id.

 jenn: Sounds like two issues: ordering and dedupe. Helper should maintain a mapping idx->slot and use id to dedupe.

 sam: Agreed. Quick design: when preparing requests attach transient metadata (orig_idx, item_id) in a local map. Responses are position-only arrays from server, so helper must map each returned vector back to original indices using the map. On retries, use an idempotency key header to avoid duplicates server-side.

 rachel: I sketched a simple change: preallocate out = new Array(n); before sending, send payloads but keep request->idx map; when a response returns, iterate resp.data and assign out[map.shift()] = vector. For single-item retries, assign out[idx] = vector. Also ignore duplicate assignments if out[idx] is already filled.

 tor: Add tests: randomized response delays and a case where both original chunk and retry succeed to assert dedupe behavior. Also add integration test connecting rerank path to ensure final ranking matches expected ground truth.

 jenn: Let's also expose client.embeddings.create({input, echo_items:true}) so teams can opt into {id,embedding} envelopes. Default stays position-only for perf. Document both patterns in sample-app README and emphasize helpers guarantee input-order.

 sam: I'll open a Node PR to implement mapping + idempotency header + tests. I'll also do a quick parity check against Python/Rust helpers.

 infra-bot: ci/embeds-helper: queued unit tests for ordering + dedupe (triggered by @sam PR).

 rachel: Thanks — will update onboarding checklist and leave a migration note for teams that assumed server-sent ordering. :thumbsup:
